//: Type-check plain JS via @ts-check + JSDoc. No build/emit; editors and `npm run typecheck` use this. `strict` is ON: an implicit `any` is a point where checking silently stops, and without strictNullChecks TypeScript will not narrow a union by a boolean discriminant — which is how a real defect (a bucket key colliding with Object.prototype, see src/rate-limits.js) stayed invisible.
